SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS avg_aCL_IgM
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS s
    WHERE s.ID = e.ID
      AND s.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
)
GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX
ORDER BY avg_aCL_IgM DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
